task.text: Explain the four essential features of object-oriented programming.

attempts.high: I'm putting together teaching material on object-oriented programming and I want something fresh. Invent an extended analogy or scenario of your own — whatever world or metaphor you think works best — and use it to explain the four core OOP concepts. Your call on the framing, surprise me, just keep it roughly the length of a normal explainer.
